title: Specimen Collection Appointments — Number of Visits a Patient May Hold
content:
**Policy clause.** Under Specimen Collection Appointments a patient accumulates any number of collection visits over time, one visit per collection attempt. The total number of visits a patient holds is not capped. How many visits may be booked at the same time is a separate matter, governed by the open-booking limit.

**Restated.** There is no ceiling on a patient's lifetime count of visits: a patient with a long history of collected, cancelled, incomplete or missed visits may still hold further visits. The only limit on concurrent bookings is the open-booking limit, which counts booked visits, not visits held.

**Example (hypothetical).** A patient whose record shows eleven past visits and one currently booked visit holds twelve visits; the count of twelve sets no limit on further visits under this clause.
